title: How to Schedule Tasks/Scripts on a Server
summary: How to schedule tasks/scripts on a Server — reference articles for customers on Windows Task Scheduler.
body_markdown:
Some articles to point customers to to help them understand how to schedule a task (like a file clean-up script) on Server:

The following web pages can help in setting up a scheduled task or script on your Server:

- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/windows-server/system-management-components/schedule-server-process
- https://devblogs.microsoft.com/scripting/using-scheduled-tasks-and-scheduled-jobs-in-powershell/
- https://sqlbackupandftp.com/blog/how-to-schedule-a-script-via-windows-task-scheduler/
- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=df-1rha9xjw
